principle_violations.reason: The sum method needs to be modified to calculate the area for new types of shapes. This violates the open/closed principle as the class is closed for modification and every time a new Shape class is added the sum function will have to be modified.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a common interface or abstract class for shapes that requires implementation of an area method. Each shape class can implement this method, allowing the AreaCalculator to simply call shape.area() and sum the results without needing to know the details of how areas are calculated for each shape.

suggestion_code:
def sum(self):
        return sum(shape.area() for shape in self.shapes)
